summary: Design AI academy pathways, skills maps and governance with measurable outcomes. Explore the course and plan your workforce learning strategy.
lede: Enterprise AI academy design helps HR, learning and transformation professionals coordinate workforce AI capability across roles and business units. Participants practise mapping AI skills and gaps with SFIA 9, designing role-based learning pathways and practice labs, and setting academy governance and impact measures, using references such as ISO 30422 and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework to connect learning plans with workplace application.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape workforce AI capability, from learning architecture and skills assessment through to executive reporting. It suits leaders and practitioners who need to coordinate AI learning across roles, business units and existing learning systems.
prerequisites: Prior experience in HR, learning and development, talent development or transformation planning is useful. No coding or programming is required.
